CREATE TABLE chat_web_account_bindings (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES chat_web_sessions(id), account_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(length(account_user_id) = 36)
  )

CREATE TABLE chat_web_preliminary_profiles (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES chat_web_sessions(id),
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, thread_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_threads(id),
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL, phone TEXT NOT NULL, consented_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    consent_version TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE chat_web_preliminary_requests (
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_web_sessions(id), request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, accepted_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(session_id,request_id)
  )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_auth_one_active ON account_auth_outcomes(company,workspace,origin,source_session_hash,chat_hash) WHERE state IN('prepared','account_committed')

CREATE TABLE account_auth_outcomes(
   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,proof_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,company TEXT NOT NULL,workspace TEXT NOT NULL,origin TEXT NOT NULL,
   action TEXT NOT NULL,source_session_hash TEXT NOT NULL,source_csrf_hash TEXT NOT NULL,chat_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
   nonce TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint TEXT,supersedes_id TEXT,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('prepared','account_committed','complete','cancelled')),
   target_user_id TEXT,target_session_hash TEXT,credential_tag TEXT,history_status TEXT,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,completed_at INTEGER
  )
